summary: Prisjakt AB (publ), through its subsidiaries, provides online price-comparison and product-discovery services in Sweden and Internationally. The company operates Prisjakt platform and the PriceSpy platform where consumers compare products, prices, and retailers. It offers home and household, beauty and health, clothing, shoes and accessories, computers and accessories, gaming and entertainment, audio and video, renovation and construction, mobile and GPS, children and family, sports and outdoor living; garden, vehicles and accessories, photo and video, household appliances and white goods, and a dedicated gamer zone products. The company offers structured product information, price listings, price-history tracking, stock status and shipping cost information, price-drop and stock-availability notifications, user-written product and retailer reviews, buying guides, articles, and expert buying advice and top-list rankings. The company also offers a mobile app with a barcode scanner for in-store price comparison and a shoptimera that compiles shopping lists and identifies the lowest total price or the fewest number of stores needed. In addition, it provides filtering and sorting tools, personalized price alerts, product tracking, and account-based list syncing. Further, it offers click-out services on a cost-per-click basis, banner advertising placements on the website and app, feeds and featured brands, and subscription-based intelligence services providing product, price, and marketing intelligence data to merchants, retailers, advertisers, and partners. It also operates Prisjakt Lite, a streamlined version of the platform used to launch and run additional markets. Prisjakt AB (publ) was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Ängelholm, Sweden.
